programme.desc: The highest grossing Chinese movie in Hong Kong history, the story tells of a barrister who swears to prove his client's innocence, going against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A Japanese security agent teams up with a master thief to recover counterfeit USD plates until a U.S. Embassy official betrays them and escapes to Korea with the prize.

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Confinement
programme.desc: A pregnant painter hires a confinement nanny, but inexplicable incidents start happening in the house as her one-month confinement begins, threatening her and her baby daughter...

programme.title: No One Like Me
programme.desc: Yang Qian Huan, once a golden boy, sees his glory fade after the birth of Xu Qi An. Yet, rising from his downfall, Yang defiantly forges his own path, refusing to bow to fate.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: The White Storm 3: Heaven or Hell
programme.desc: Two undercover cops successfully develop a brotherly bond with a Thai drug lord. When the police busts the syndicate, the drug lord discovers that there is betrayal within his circle of trust...

programme.title: Rob N Roll
programme.desc: A ruthless bandit plots a major heist which is joined by two dispirited men inadvertently. Their ad-hoc and dramatic robbery lands them in a fierce police pursuit, putting their lives on the line!

programme.title: True Love For Once In My Life
programme.desc: Sabrina's deep love for Andrew is shattered by his affair which ends their marriage. Years later, she returns to care for him as he is diagnosed with cancer, believing that true love comes only once.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a retired stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. But due to his debts, he might lose his horse, so he seeks help from his estranged daughter & her boyfriend.

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: A baby hatch that never closes faces moral backlash. Nevertheless, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie, and Nuru remain committed to helping desperate mothers and abandoned newborns.

programme.title: All U Need is Love
programme.desc: When a luxury hotel in Hong Kong suddenly becomes a Coronavirus superspreader, guests & the staff are faced with a 14-day trial they may not survive.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: A sozzled police inspector (Jackie Chan) must pull himself up again after a bungled mission causes his entire team to be wiped out.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Set in 2020 during the outbreak of COVID-19, the movie features interconnected stories of three women's lives as they navigate the uncertain future amongst their respective friends and families.

programme.title: I Did it My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive dark world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and secret operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor & a professional assassin.

programme.title: My Blue Summer
programme.desc: Zhi has been secretly in love with high school classmate Nan from the moment they met. They finally become close friends when they entered the same university, but will Zhi ever confess his feelings?

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: Specializing in overseas security jobs, The Wolf Pack discovers that terrorists are planning to destroy the country's energy source. Lead by Lao Diao, the pack must move out to stop them!

programme.title: I Still Remember
programme.desc: An uplifting sports drama focusing on a property agent who leads an aimless, unfulfilling life & his P.E teacher, as they seek to find purpose in their lives.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: After years of self-neglect, Le Ying decides to embrace life anew. Meeting a boxing coach sparks her desire for a fresh start. Despite the challenges ahead, she embarks on a transformative journey.

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: The death of a charity's CFO and a missing donation force lawyer Ma into an alliance with a police officer. Together, they risk everything to uncover the charity's darkest secrets and seek justice.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai is framed for murder. He takes hostages at the police station and demands talk with a former negotiator. As they engage in a tense battle of wits, their perspectives gradually shift.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: In a world without dreams, a monster wanders through a vanishing dreamworld. A woman who can see its hidden visions ventures deep into its dreams to seek the buried truth.

programme.title: Twilight of the Warriors: Walled In
programme.desc: Young Chan Lok Kwun accidentally stumbles into the dangerous Kowloon Walled City, subsequently finding purpose amid chaos and gaining wisdom while becoming one of the City's protectors.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: When an engaged couple is requested to invite their parents for a CNY client event, the fiance - who is estranged from his mother, fakes a family. However, things spiral out of control.

programme.title: My First Of May
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife are devastated by their daughter's muscular dystrophy. Years later, the faint movement of her pinky finger gives them a small but powerful sign of hope.

programme.title: Back Home
programme.desc: Wing, who can see ghosts since young, discovers that the visions that once haunted him have become worse in his home. Caught between the living and dead, Wing must bring the truth to light to be free.

programme.title: The Lychee Road
programme.desc: A single lychee triggers a Tang Dynasty "Mission Impossible"! Junior official Li races 1,000 miles in three days to satisfy a consort's craving - an epic ride of tension, humour and biting satire!

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his friend Meow flee after Meow's attempt to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, their paths cross when Meow's life is in danger again. Will Chai choose loyalty over duty?

programme.title: MUMU
programme.desc: Mumu connects her deaf father to the outside world, but their peaceful life is disrupted when she must adapt and fit in to the hearing world, while her father is ensnared by a gang to commit crime.

programme.title: Blades of the Guardians: Wind Rises in the Desert
programme.desc: Fugitive bounty hunter Dao Ma escorts the most wanted fugitive across the desert to Chang'an, only to be drawn into a plot that threatens war between the imperial court and the martial world.

programme.title: L Storm
programme.desc: ICAC officer Luk and Inspector Lau are stuck in their investigation for bribery and money laundering cases. Framed for bribery, Luk risks everything to gather evidence to clear his name.

programme.title: Out of Order
programme.desc: A successful lawyer's secret affair turns into a nightmare when a corpse unexpectedly turns up in the hotel room, triggering a desperate cover-up that spirals into uncontrollable chaos.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive.

programme.title: Victim(s)
programme.desc: After a ruthless Kuala Lumpur student murders his classmate, the victim's mother and the killer's mother uncover hidden truths about their sons and face very different paths of grief and torment.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse?

programme.title: Bodyguards and Assassins
programme.desc: Winner of 8 HKFA awards & featuring an all-star cast, this film depicts an elite team guarding Dr Sun Yat Sen in Hong Kong, as he discusses plans to overthrow the Qing dynasty.

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: Hong Kong's survival is at risk due to a radiation leak. A fire brigade is assigned to stop cesium fallout by entering the radiation zone. Facing this unprecedented disaster, can they save the city?

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, the murder of a white woman in Chinatown ignites public outrage. Two Chinese detectives race against time to uncover the true killer amid mounting tension and danger.

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Yam Tai Foon, a wealthy man is unhappy with his son's failed marriage and Kwai's dream of being a comic artist. He pins hopes on his daughter, On, but she returns from France with wild Ruberto.

programme.title: Inexternal
programme.desc: Ming falls into coma and is transported to a fantasy realm where old Master Turtle teaches him ancient boxing skill to defeat an evil boss. Meanwhile, Ming's mother finds a way to save her son.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream?

programme.title: CJ7
programme.desc: When a poor laborer picks up a toy for his son from a dumpster, the events that follow teach them about the true nature of family and things money can't buy.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
